checks: Real keyboard jump earns points; historical score geometry still matches for the earned value.
Portrait/short/portrait/narrow rotation keeps score and mode readable without changing the historical score position.
Touch hold through the bottom label reaches the game canvas; an invincible miss returns without changing the earned score.
Touch menu toggles to normal mode; the compact label updates without overlapping controls or score.
Normal failure hides the gameplay HUD, retains the real settlement score, and replay restores a readable normal-mode HUD.
Home and skins keep the gameplay HUD hidden; returning to play preserves normal mode and saved best.
